summary: Pixel donut chart of storage use that sweeps in clockwise; pointing at a segment pushes its pixels outward and click pins it.

events.name: select
events.description: Fires when a segment is pinned or unpinned. `segment` is the category name, or `null` when the pin is cleared.

methods.description: Pins the segment at `index` (0 to 4), or unpins it if it is already pinned or `index` is `null`, and fires `select`. Other values are ignored.

properties.name: active
properties.description: Index of the pinned segment, else the hovered one, else `null`.

accessibility: The ring canvas has `role="img"` with an `aria-label` listing every category and its size.
The legend entries are native buttons with `aria-pressed` for the pinned segment; focusing one highlights its segment like hover.
The centre readout is plain text without a live region.
motion: With reduced motion, the ring appears without the clockwise sweep, segments move out without easing and the idle shimmer stops.
notes: The categories are built-in demo data: Projects 3.2 GB, Files 2.1 GB, Chats 1.5 GB, Memory 0.9 GB and Free 2.3 GB, out of 10 GB.
The ring is a fixed 200 by 200px, with the legend beside it or below it when space is narrow.

data.note: The storage categories and their sizes are invented; nothing can be set.
